record.rationale: The browser HTML and clipboard adapters need a narrow, browser-neutral filter boundary for transfer DTO validation; canonical SwTextNode and SwpHints retain only text and hint ownership.
responsibilities: Defines shared filter transfer records and normalizes untrusted browser/clipboard run DTOs before they enter canonical Writer text and hints.

stackDivergence.rationale: Structured browser transfer records have no native Writer model counterpart and remain in the filter boundary.
